answer: Smoking is not allowed inside the apartments, on the balconies, or in the corridors. The only place in the building where smoking is allowed is the marked smoking corner at the north end of the roof terrace, which is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

The shared roof terrace has seating and city views. It is open **7:00 AM to 10:00 PM**. It is a quiet space: no loud music, no gatherings, no parties and no barbecues. Tips for Different Kinds of Guests > 20.1 Families with children

- Ask for the free travel cot or high chair at least 48 hours before arrival (section 15.1).
- Keep balcony doors locked when small children are in the apartment, and never leave children alone on the balcony or terrace.
- Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult in the lifts and on the roof terrace.
- The Two-Bedroom and the Penthouse are the best choices for families because they have separate bedrooms and washing machines.
- Remember that children aged 2 and above count as guests for occupancy and for the extra guest fee (sections 2.1 and 2.2)."},{"source_id":"11.8","title":"Open flames and barbecues","text":"House manual > 11. House Rules > 11.8 Open flames and barbecues
